scope: First broad namadhatu expansion over the declared laukika nominal inventory, followed by a source-demonstrated pass for the narrower rules in 3.1.12-3.1.21.

broad_operations.semantic_relation: desire the nominal referent in relation to oneself
desire the nominal referent in relation to oneself

broad_operations.operation_display: क्यच् (kyac), conduct toward an object by comparison
broad_operations.semantic_relation: treat an object as comparable to the nominal referent

broad_operations.operation_display: क्यङ् (kyaṅ), conduct of an agent by comparison

conditioned_rule_relations.3.1.12: become or present as the quality denoted by the nominal referent
conditioned_rule_relations.3.1.13: become or present as the state denoted by the nominal referent
conditioned_rule_relations.3.1.14: undertake crooked or wrongful conduct associated with the nominal referent
conditioned_rule_relations.3.1.16: emit the substance denoted by the nominal referent
conditioned_rule_relations.3.1.17: produce or perform the nominal referent
conditioned_rule_relations.3.1.18: experience the state denoted by the nominal referent directly
conditioned_rule_relations.3.1.21: perform the source-specified action associated with the nominal referent

additional_conditioned_relations.semantic_relation: put on or wear a robe
additional_conditioned_relations.source_basis: Kāśikā on 3.1.20 expressly gives both acquisition and wearing
